boards.title: The visitors' board
boards.note: The same board in SVG (/stickers Board), in three.js (/stickers 3D) and in VR (the sticker_board artifact).

boards.title: The research, in stickers
boards.note: One sticker per spine sequence of Ada Research, in spine order: its idea as a motif, its name, its question; the colour is its QFEP phase. Derived by tools/stickers_seed.ts from commons/maps/curriculum_spine.json and the sequence files.

boards.title: Paradoxes and punctums
boards.note: What the texts hold true at once (paradoxes: the split badges) and the details in them that prick (punctums: the photograph prints), each with the line it reads. Chosen from 112 candidates read out of the hall texts and the framework; tools/stickers_seed.ts checks that every line is still in its text (commons/data/stickers/readings.json).

boards.title: Paradoxes and punctums, threaded
boards.note: The 28 readings hung on cords in front of the cork, each theme at its own depth, tied by the threads the texts hold between them: thick dark red where two or three readers found a thread on their own. Tie, cut and relabel threads, and move the stickers in depth, at /stickers.

boards.title: The edges of the research
boards.note: Where the research says, in its own words, that it stops: what it cannot claim, leaves out, has not yet built or walked, still holds open, forecloses, keeps in a dark spot or cannot fit. Each a torn piece of the research's map with the line it was read from; tools/stickers_seed.ts checks every line is still in its text (commons/data/stickers/readings.json, kind edge).
